column1: # Negative controls of the installed package (Phase 11, plan 11-19, VER-05).
# One row, one CTest name: tools/abi/CMakeLists.txt registers installed.controls.<id>
# for every row, and `sh scripts/check-install.sh control <id>` performs it.
# Columns are separated by one TAB: id, action, argument, kind, expected, detail.
#   action    what the driver does (configure-missing, configure-version,
#   kind      text: the combined output of the action contains the expected text
#             status: the create status the smoke case printed equals the number
#   expected  the exact text or status number, a control passes only when it is
#             observed, and its log states the expected and the observed value
# The doctored rows change a copy of the installed header, never the source header.
# No semicolons or brackets in a row: CMake reads this file as a list of lines.
